[CRITICAL] [LOGIC] Event name change breaks both subscribers (`createUser`)

- Issue: `createUser` now emits `"userCreated"`, but `src/notifications/subscribers.js` subscribes to `"user:created"`. Every successful user creation will therefore skip both `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup`, producing missing welcome emails and analytics.
- Fix: Emit the event name used by the registered subscribers, or update all relevant producers and consumers together. If the rename is intentional, change `bus.on("user:created", ...)` registrations to `bus.on("userCreated", ...)` in the same change.

* [CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks subscriber chain (at bus.emit in createUser)
  - Issue: The event name is changed from "user:created" to "userCreated", but subscribers in src/notifications/subscribers.js are still listening for "user:created". This causes welcome emails and signup tracking to silently never fire when users are created.
  - Fix: Either update the emit to `bus.emit("user:created", user)` to match existing subscribers, or update all subscribers to listen for "userCreated" instead.

[CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch (bus.emit)
- Issue: The emit changed to "userCreated", but listeners in src/notifications/subscribers.js are registered for "user:created". Consequently, the listeners never fire, causing missing welcome emails and analytics tracking.
- Fix: Revert bus.emit to "user:created" to keep listeners triggered.

    - Fix: Revert the event name to "user:created" to match existing subscribers[WARNING] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks subscriber notifications (at bus.emit)

    - Fix: Revert the event name to "user:created" to match existing subscribers.
